name: Summons: no monlvl.txt attack rating or defense
description: Removes the two monlvl.txt stat additions that the shared summon stat setter applies to every pet on creation. With this applied, a summon's attack rating and defense come only from its own monstats.txt row and from the summoning skill's aurastat/passivestat columns, so the numbers you author are the numbers the pet has. Applies to every summon in the mod. Verified against the D2R 3.3 D2RLoader image.

patches.description: Skip the monlvl.txt AC column add (stat 31, armorclass). Call to the add-stat helper, void, four register arguments, no stack arguments, so removing it is stack neutral and nothing downstream reads its result.
Skip the monlvl.txt TH column add (stat 19, tohit). This is the one responsible for summons carrying five figure attack rating at high level.
